adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` to call `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb), which in turn calls `record_for_host` and performs `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb). That is a DB query on each request to the public `/embed/comments` endpoint. The migration creating `embeddable_hosts` adds no index on `host` (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb), and `lower(host)` would not use a normal index anyway, so this is a concrete performance concern introduced by the change, not a functional correctness defect.
